text:
Sasha Li: Quick ask — can we borrow 4 x A100 (40GB) in ap-northeast1 for a late-sprint smoke run on Tue 03:00 UTC? Need ~90m window, nothing persistent.
Maria Gomez: What timezone is that in local APAC teams? We usually do midnight maintenance windows, 03:00 UTC is 12:00 JST, might conflict with some scheduled demos.
Sasha Li: Right — it’s actually targeted to CI that trigg ers before the release cut. If we can't get A100s we can try H100 preemptible, but perf variance might flake a couple of heavy throughput tests.
Tony Park: Do we have a fallback plan in the demo pool? I can check but the demo fleet is booked for customer run-throughs.
Neha Rao: Tagging this to my PR #4127 (infra/ephemeral-gpu). I added an ephemeral pool TF module we can spin up in the sandbox org if quotas allow. Minimal plan: 4 x a2-highgpu-1 (40GB) instances and a single nfs.
Neha Rao: snippet:```terraform
module "ephemeral_gpu" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@repo/infra-modules.git//gpu-ephemeral"
  count  = 1
  gpu_type = "A100-40GB"
  qty      = 4
  ttl      = "120m"
}
```
Maria Gomez: Nice — infra-oncall will still need quota bump for the sandbox project. Sasha, did you already open a quota request?
Sasha Li: Not yet, wanted to check with vendor first — vendor contact said "short inventory hold" might exist. If not, I'll open the request and tag infra-oncall.
vendor-bot: Vendor update: partner pool has 2x A100-40GB available in ap-northeast1, additional units on backorder. ETA for replenishment ~14 days. (see https://vendor.example.com/order/789)
Tony Park: OK that means we either borrow 2 from partner + 2 from demo pool or run mixed A100/H100. Mixed runs will slightly shift thresholds but fine for smoke only.
Neha Rao: If we do mixed, can we mark the two heavier tests to skip via env var? I can add SKIP_HEAVY=true toggle to the CI job in the PR.
Sasha Li: Yes please — add toggle and I'll open the quota request in parallel. If infra-oncall approves demo-borrow, we can go green.
infra-bot: Quota request submitted: Q-2026-789 (sandbox-project). Requested +4 GPUs (A100-40GB) for 2h window on Tue 03:00 UTC. Please react :eyes: to acknowledge.
Maria Gomez: Reacted. Also leaving a note for support to warn customers for potential demo pool borrow.
Tony Park: I'll ping the demo team and hold 2 units tentatively.
Neha Rao: PR #4127 updated with SKIP_HEAVY; also added a short smoke checklist in the PR description.
Sasha Li: Thanks everyone — plan B (mixed pool) ready, plan A (full A100) preferred. Will post final run decision 12 hours before start.
Maria Gomez: Sounds good. If quota fails, let's run the smoke with H100 preemptible in eu-central as a last resort and move results over.
Sasha Li: Noted. I'll keep the thread updated. :rocket:
